dedupe_keys.name: first street foundation national flood adaptation database grey and green flood protection sample

description: This database records grey and green flood protection and climate adaptation projects across the contiguous United States, built by First Street Foundation to feed its national flood model. Grey projects include levees, pump stations and flood control channels; green projects include wetland restoration, floodable open space, retention basins and creek rehabilitation, and adaptation projects include beach renourishment. Records are collected from state, county and city agencies and digitised as the area a structure protects, with the source of flooding it addresses and a level of protection expressed as the return period to which it keeps working; service areas range from a few blocks to a small city. The data are used in the hydraulic and hydrologic model in several ways. The Zenodo release (June 2020, CC BY 4.0) contains two sample shapefiles, for coastal and inland adaptation, of about 2 MB in total. Caveats: only a sample is openly downloadable, protection levels are estimated, not certified, and the full database sits behind First Street products. It supports flood exposure modelling that accounts for existing protection and scenario tests of green and grey adaptation; a related record is First Street property flood risk statistics.
name: First Street Foundation National Flood Adaptation Database (grey and green flood protection, sample)
